leadership: Tess van Stekelenburg — Partner (co-founder of portfolio company Valthos)
profile.model: Deep-tech generalist that backs 'scientific risk' companies across biology, AI, defense and hardware from a single fund rather than a separate bio vehicle. In life sciences it co-founds companies around star academic founders (Kallyope, Kala) and invests early in platform biotechs that pair high-throughput biology with machine learning, increasingly at the AI-bio and biosecurity interface (EvolutionaryScale, Valthos).
profile.summary: Lux was an early investor in Recursion and has co-founded or seeded a run of platform biotechs built on top-tier academic science, from Kallyope to Eikon and Cajal. Its cross-sector AI exposure positions it as a prominent backer of protein foundation models and AI-native drug discovery.
